jobs.description:
Start as an experienced order picker on the permanent night shift at Kuehne+Nagel in Tessenderlo!

As an experienced order picker on the permanent night shift, you will join the team handling the exclusive toy department at Kuehne+Nagel in Tessenderlo. During the night shift, you will oversee the accurate processing, quality control and preparation for shipment of outgoing goods. Thanks to your logistics experience, night-time operations run smoothly, ensuring every order is ready for transport on time.

Our AI agent will contact you via WhatsApp to ask a few questions and verify that you meet the job's minimum requirements. A consultant will always review your application and determine the next steps. If you have questions about this screening process, please contact us by applying for this vacancy or by reaching out to your nearest Randstad office.

Ready to start a long-term role? Call 011 54 92 85 or email talentcenter1@randstad.be!

VG 458/BUOSAP

• You have at least 6 months of experience as an order picker in a warehouse or distribution environment.
• You have a good command of Dutch or English to correctly follow safety and work instructions.
• You are physically fit, energetic, and looking for a long-term position on a permanent night shift.
• You have access to your own transport to reach the site in Tessenderlo independently (public transport is not an option).
Your responsibilities as an order picker:

• Picking orders using a handheld scanner or voice-picking system.
• Thoroughly checking product codes, quantities, and packaging quality.
• Carefully packing and preparing goods for shipment in accordance with strict guidelines.
• Monitoring stock levels and immediately reporting any discrepancies.
• Operating internal transport equipment (such as an electric pallet truck) and maintaining a safe, orderly work environment.

jobs.occupation: Reach Truck Driver - Logent (Evergem / region Ghent, Belgium)
jobs.description:
• Safely operating reach trucks to maneuver, stack, retrieve, and store palletized goods in high-bay warehouse racks.

Handling inbound and outbound freight trucks with precision to guarantee damage-free logistics handling.

•

•   
You are available for a 2-shift rotation or a fixed night shift and align with our collective closure schedule (3 weeks in late July/early August and the Christmas/New Year holiday period).

jobs.occupation: Internship - Digitalization & AI for Wiper Blade Testing
jobs.description:
Your challenge

Join our wiper blade test department and help us make our testing processes smarter, more standardized and data-driven. You will work on practical digitalization and AI solutions together with our test engineers.

Your main tasks

• Test specification standardization
• Compare existing wiper blade test specifications and identify opportunities for complexity reduction.
• Standardize test descriptions and required information.
• Develop an AI-based solution to easily compare specifications and highlight differences.
• AI for test reports
• Develop an AI solution to search and analyze historical test reports.
• Investigate how the quality and structure of existing data can be improved.
• Create a standardized template for future test reports to enable effective AI-based analysis.
• Digitalization of test equipment
• Update the test equipment inventory, including equipment locations.
• Support the preparation and entry of equipment data into the new laboratory management system planned for 2027.
• Wiper arm digitalization & 3D scanning
• Create an inventory of available wiper arms and link them to the existing wiper arm library.
• Support the digitalization of wiper arms using 3D scanning.

• Bachelor or Master student with a technical/engineering background, for example mechanical, automotive, electromechanical or industrial engineering.
• A strong interest in digitalization and Artificial Intelligence.
• An analytical and structured way of working.
• Motivation to work with technical specifications, test reports and engineering data.
• Good communication skills and the ability to work closely with test engineers.
• Good written and spoken English, as you will work with technical specifications, reports and colleagues in an international environment.

Our customer is a leading international company active in the development, production, and distribution of high-quality products for the dental industry. They are looking for a Transport Officer. 

As a Transport Officer, you will be responsible for organizing and monitoring transport activities to ensure timely, cost-effective, and high-quality deliveries

Your Responsibilities

• Organize the collection of completed orders using the SAP transport module or by entering shipments into the appropriate transport software.
• Coordinate with transport partners to ensure timely collections and provide all required shipping documentation (pick-up lists, invoices, etc.).
• Communicate delivery schedules and transport documentation to customers and internal stakeholders.
• Collaborate with various departments and external partners to resolve delivery issues and transport-related complaints.
• Support the loading of pallets and cartons onto trucks when required.
• Accept small incoming shipments and coordinate their internal distribution on site.
• Provide administrative support to the Logistics Transport Supervisor.

Your Profile

• Proven experience with the SAP transport module.
• Knowledge of customs regulations is an asset.
• Familiarity with dangerous goods regulations (IATA and ADR).
• Excellent command of Dutch and English; knowledge of French is a plus.
• Advanced user of Microsoft Office, particularly Excel, Word, and Outlook.
• Willing to work a fixed schedule of 08:00 to 16:30.
• Strong communication and organizational skills.
• Positive, hands-on, and proactive mindset.

jobs.occupation: Extrusion Operator – 2 Shifts & Permanent Night Shift
jobs.description:
For a company in regio Wielsbeke we are looking for motivated and technically skilled Extrusion Operators to join the production team. We have opportunities available in both a two-shift system (early and late shifts) and a permanent night shift.

As an Extrusion Operator, you will be responsible for operating and monitoring extrusion machinery to ensure efficient production and consistent product quality.

 

Key Responsibilities:

• Operate and monitor extrusion machines and production lines.

• Set up machines and adjust process parameters according to production requirements.

• Monitor product quality and ensure compliance with quality standards.

• Perform routine quality checks and make adjustments when necessary.

• Identify and report machine malfunctions or production issues.

• Carry out basic cleaning and maintenance tasks.

• Follow all health, safety, and production procedures.

• Work closely with colleagues and supervisors to achieve production targets.

 

Your Profile:

• Experience in extrusion or a similar production environment is an advantage.

• Technical understanding and a hands-on approach.

• Strong attention to detail and commitment to quality.

• Ability to work independently as well as part of a team.

• Flexible and willing to work either a two-shift system or a permanent night shift.

• Reliable, motivated, and eager to learn.

• You speak English or Dutch fluently.
